q: Which grid factor should an Indian group use for its overseas subsidiaries?
title: Grid factor for overseas subsidiaries
short: Use the grid factor of the country where each site uses the power, not India's 0.710. Calculate each site's Scope 2 with its own national or regional factor, then add them up in the group report and list the factor and source per site.
audience: Indian groups with factories or offices abroad

ul: UK sites: the UK Government conversion factors for that year.
Other countries: the national published factor, or IEA data where none is published.
India: CEA CO2 Baseline Database, 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh.

p: Contracts and certificates count only in the market where the site is supplied.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
